snippet.title: Signal Veil - Cast Reveal: Yurie Hoyoyon | PC, PS5, Switch 2, Xbox X|S @Signal_Veil_official
snippet.description:
Meet Yurie Hoyoyon, the official voice actress behind Aki Mizuno, the protagonist of Signal Veil (@Signal_Veil_official).

Signal Veil is a classic-inspired psychological survival horror game blending ’90s anime aesthetics, fixed-camera perspectives, and atmospheric storytelling.

Coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and the Epic Games Store.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4528010/Signal_Veil/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020814/
Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/p/signal-veil-80c9fe

After inheriting her mother’s old phone, Aki begins experiencing supernatural phenomena no one else can see. As her seemingly ordinary school reveals a disturbing past buried beneath false memories and silence, Aki must confront grotesque spirits, impossible messages, and a fractured reality.

Explore tense environments through classic fixed camera angles, use Aki’s phone to detect supernatural entities and reveal what cannot normally be seen, and survive with limited resources and tactical combat.

Listen to the signal. Face what lies beyond the veil.

Follow us:
https://x.com/Signal_veil 
https://www.instagram.com/signal_veil/
